_comment: Named constants that are DELIBERATELY bound to two values in this document, because the
document records both what a spec asked for and what shipped. Everything not on this list is
a genuine internal contradiction and fails the run.
This list must stay short and each entry must be justified. It is the one place where the
consistency check can be silenced, so silencing it is a reviewable act. Adding an entry to
hide a contradiction you introduced is the failure mode.

reasons.FIRST_EVENT_AT: Recorded supersession. The spec specified 50 s or first-objective completion; the shipped scheduler is timer-only at 30. Both numbers are load-bearing - one is the intent, the other the behaviour - and section 14 states the difference explicitly.
